summary: Iteration 3 full test of the new Stripe payments / animation tool / team invites / 3D terrain preview / plugin-code features. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (17 pytest cases) - ALL 17 PASS covering payments catalog (4 packs pack_100/150/200/2000 + 2 annual plans pro_annual/studio_annual with save_pct=20), checkout for pack_2000 & studio_annual (returns https checkout.stripe.com URL + cs_test_ session, transaction row 'initiated'/'pending'/granted=false), invalid item_id -> 400, unknown session -> 404, auth gates, team invite full lifecycle (create/list/role-update/delete + persistence re-GET), duplicate -> 409, self-invite -> 400, invalid role -> 400, bad email -> 422, FREE-plan user -> 403 on invite and can_manage=false, and /api/plugin/code (Luau, contains create_animation + X-API-Key + bridge/poll polling loop). ANIMATION TOOL verified via /app/backend/tests/sse_probe_animation.py: prompt 'Animate the selected part to spin forever and fade out' streamed 2 x create_animation actions at cost 4 each (+1 write_script), done event credits_used=16, and both create_animation commands are queued in /api/workspace/commands with correct payloads (goal/duration/easing/repeat_count=-1) and no _id leakage. STRIPE E2E PAYMENT COMPLETED FOR REAL (Stripe Checkout WAS reachable from the test browser): clicked buy-pack_100 -> redirected to checkout.stripe.com -> paid with 4242 4242 4242 4242 / 12-30 / 123 -> redirected back to /payment/success?session_id=... -> page showed 'Payment successful / 100 credits added to your account'. Credits went 133 -> 233 and 4 additional GET /api/payments/status/{sid} polls all returned status=completed, payment_status=paid, granted=true with credits STILL 233 => grant is idempotent. FRONTEND: Billing credits tab shows all 4 buy-<id> buttons with pack_2000 marked BEST VALUE at $200 / 2,000 credits; tab-annual shows both annual cards with SAVE 20% badges, $144/$192 and struck-through monthly comparison. /payment/cancel renders the 'Payment cancelled - No charge was made' card. /team as Studio user: invite-form -> shadcn role Select -> send-invite-btn added member row (status pending, role Edit), role change Edit->View persisted across reload, remove-<id> deleted the row. /settings download-plugin-btn opens dialog with full Luau code (create_animation + X-API-Key present) and copy-plugin-code-btn. /workspace ONE terrain prompt: terrain-3d-preview rendered with 'BIOME: GRASS / 400x60x400 studs / bounding box - 120 scatter' plus the animated voxel box, and action cards action-sculpt_terrain / action-paint_terrain_material / action-scatter_assets all present; cost preview said '~31+ credits (min)' vs actual 30 (now accurate). Regression OK: login, credit-balance header, 8 sidebar routes, mobile drawer at 390px opens with all links. TWO real bugs found (see frontend_issues): the /api-keys frontend route is swallowed by the /api* ingress proxy, and the clipboard copy handlers crash with an uncaught runtime-error overlay.

minor.issue: NO auth dependency and no ownership check - any unauthenticated caller who knows/guesses a cs_test_ session id can read item_id, amount-equivalent credits, payment_status and granted for another user's transaction, AND can trigger the inline Stripe fetch + _grant side effect on someone else's session. Add Depends(get_verified_user) and assert tx['user_id'] == user['id'].

origin_url is taken straight from the client and used to build success_url/cancel_url with no allow-list, so an attacker can make Stripe redirect a paying user to an arbitrary domain (open-redirect / phishing vector). Validate origin_url against the known frontend origin.
Missing the _require_team(user) plan gate that POST and PUT have. Inconsistent (harmless today because deletes are scoped by owner_id, but a downgraded Pro->Free user can still mutate team state).

Reuses InviteBody so the client must send a required `email` field that is completely ignored by the handler - only role is applied. A role-only body returns 422. Should use a dedicated RoleBody model.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is called with no .catch(). Clicking copy-plugin-code-btn in a context where clipboard write permission is denied throws NotAllowedError, which surfaces as a FULL-SCREEN red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay that blocks the whole app (reproduced, screenshot captured). The success toast also fires optimistically even though the copy failed. Wrap all 3 call sites in try/catch (Settings.jsx:27, ApiKeys.jsx:86, Workspace.jsx:275) with a document.execCommand fallback and only toast on success.

HIGH: the ApiKeys page is mounted at /api-keys, but the Kubernetes ingress proxies EVERY path starting with /api to the FastAPI backend. Direct navigation / hard refresh / bookmark / share of https://<host>/api-keys returns raw JSON {"detail":"Not Found"} instead of the React page (verified). Only in-app client-side navigation works. Rename the route to /keys or /bridge-keys and update the sidebar link.
LOW: no catch-all <Route path="*"> - an unknown URL (/does-not-exist-xyz) renders a completely blank dark page with no 404 message or link back.

LOW testability gap: only back-to-workspace-btn has a data-testid, and it only exists on the success variant. The cancel card, the 'checking' spinner state and the result heading/credits text have no data-testid, so the polling states cannot be asserted deterministically (I had to fall back to body innerText).

LOW: before any text is typed the element reads 'Cost preview appears as you type' - fine, but note the estimate only appears after input, so an automated/first-time user sees no price until they type.

issues: The pack_2000 'BEST VALUE' card is taller than its 3 siblings (the badge is added inside the card flow instead of absolutely positioned), so the 4 'Buy pack' buttons are not baseline-aligned across the row - visible misalignment at 1920px.

The large 'Luau Preview' panel occupies the top ~330px of the right column showing only the 'Generated Luau will appear here' placeholder when the plan produces no write_script action. Consider collapsing it when empty so Toolbox & Terrain moves up.

action_items: Rename the /api-keys frontend route (e.g. to /keys) - it is currently unreachable by direct URL because the ingress sends /api* to the backend

Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch (Settings.jsx:27, ApiKeys.jsx:86, Workspace.jsx:275) - a denied clipboard permission currently crashes the app with a full-screen error overlay, and the success toast lies
Add auth + ownership check to GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} (currently fully public and side-effecting)
Validate/allow-list origin_url in POST /api/payments/checkout (open-redirect via Stripe success_url)
Add _require_team gate to DELETE /api/team/invite/{id} and give PUT a role-only body model (email is required but ignored)
Add a <Route path="*"> 404 page (unknown URLs render a blank screen)
Add data-testid to the PaymentResult cancel card / checking state / result heading
Align the 4 credit-pack card heights (absolutely position the BEST VALUE badge)
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py: /status is the only money-touching endpoint with no Depends(get_verified_user); it both leaks another user's transaction data and can be used to force a grant on a session the caller does not own.

payments.py: the `except Exception: pass` around the Stripe status fetch silently swallows Stripe/network errors, so a real Stripe outage looks identical to 'not paid yet' to the frontend poller - log the exception at minimum.

payments.py _grant(): the credit $inc on users and the granted=True flag on the transaction are two separate awaits with no transaction; a crash between them double-credits on the next poll. Prefer flipping granted first with a conditional update_one(granted:{$ne:True}) and only $inc when modified_count==1.
team.py: PUT /invite/{id} reuses InviteBody, forcing clients to send a meaningless required email; Team.jsx already works around this by passing memberEmail. Introduce a RoleBody {role} model.
team.py: invites are only keyed on owner_id+email in application code - add a compound unique index so the 409 duplicate check is not racy.
config.py: PAYMENT_CATALOG prices are server-authoritative (good) - keep it that way; the frontend correctly sends only item_id.
Frontend: three separate copy-to-clipboard implementations - extract a single copyToClipboard(text) helper with error handling and reuse it.

rca_of_the_issue: /api-keys route: the Kubernetes ingress rule routes any request path prefixed with /api to backend port 8001 before React Router ever sees it. Because the ApiKeys page is registered at path='/api-keys', a browser GET of https://<host>/api-keys hits FastAPI, which has no such route and answers 404 {"detail":"Not Found"}. It only appears to work in-app because client-side <Link> navigation never issues a document request. Fix = rename the path to something not starting with /api. Clipboard bug: navigator.clipboard.writeText returns a promise; Settings.jsx:27, ApiKeys.jsx:86 and Workspace.jsx:275 call it fire-and-forget and immediately toast.success, so a NotAllowedError (permission denied / non-focused document) becomes an unhandled rejection that CRA's dev overlay renders full-screen.
